provenance.provenance_evidence: The project-owned projection passage reproduces the retained calendar body hash exactly. Its artifact manifest records the bounded public-domain 1862 Pustet antecedent, the separate 1962 target, and every editorial transformation; neither witness is represented as owning the projected bytes. The 1962 reading was established on that edition's page images rather than its text layer, cross-read against the Benziger conformed printing. Differences from the antecedent: 1862 prints the short conclusion cue where the 1962 writes the conclusion out in full (12 tokens); 1862 layer carries a stray semicolon token from column spacing; 1862 text layer renders six printed accents as & or £ and shows two letterform confusions (ti for u, u for n); no word differs. Corroboration: Mame 1922, printed p. 597, PDF p. 711 right column, lines 17-23: all 25 words of the petition agree with the 1962 and with the 1862, and the Mame reads correctly at the two places the 1862 layer damages; the Mame abbreviates the conclusion.

propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Deus, qui hunc diem beati Venantii Martyris tui triumpho consecrasti: exaudi
preces populi tui, et praesta; ut, qui ejus merita veneramur, fidei
constantiam imitemur. Per Dominum nostrum Jesum Christum, Filium tuum: Qui
tecum vivit et regnat in unitate.

translations.caution:
A lay hand missal of the 1945 revision, printed about 1955-56, not an approved liturgical translation and never an altar book. Its Holy Week is the pre-1955 rite, its sanctoral is not the 1962 sanctoral, and its second and third orations are not those of 1962. It is carried only where a 1962 formulary is the same prayer, and nothing here may be used for recitation.

Historical source s-venantii-martyris/main/Collect/all/1; same-witness-conclusion-table. Complete petitions equal and actual Latin conclusion prefixes match the same printed family through-our-lord at passage.francis-xavier-lasance.the-new-roman-missal.benziger-revised-1945.resume-orations-conclusion-table-2026-10-23-verify; tracked rule/formula passage.francis-xavier-lasance.the-new-roman-missal.benziger-revised-1945.resume-orations-conclusion-table-2026-10-23-transcription. Cross-owner reuse requires entire literal canonical Latin equality including conclusion, punctuation, wraps and final LF, SHA256 20464f114b0ab8c86feb38ac450fd26eb1575282a671620b0f00025631e542d5.
